headline: Solex Energy Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about issuance of Compulsorily Convertible Debentures (CCDs) by the Wholly Owned Subsidiary i.e. Solex New Energy Private Limited with an option to convert the said CCDs into…
detail: General Updates - Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about issuance of Compulsorily Convertible Debentures (CCDs) by the Wholly Owned Subsidiary i.e. Solex New Energy Private Limited with an option to convert the said CCDs into Equity Shares of Solex Energy Limited (Swap Shares), aggregating to Rs. 150 Crores in one or more tranches, subject to the terms and conditions specified therein and completion of applicable statutory and regulatory formalities

sources.name: NSE filing - Solex Energy Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
